title: 中国人怎么吃一只鸡①大盘鸡：这道'新疆名菜'，其实只有40岁 | How China Eats a Chicken P1 · Xinjiang Big-Plate 🍗
description:
第一个吃到大盘鸡的卡车司机，会想到它火遍全国吗？

中国人怎么吃一只鸡 第①集 · 新疆大盘鸡。看着像百年名吃，它其实很「年轻」——据多方记载，大盘鸡诞生于1980年代后期新疆塔城地区沙湾县312国道旁，创制者是四川籍厨师李士林（1987年在沙湾开店）。最初是给长途货车司机的「量大、实惠、下饭」菜：整鸡爆炒，用醒面的大托盘盛上桌，客人一句「来盘大盘子鸡」，名字就这么叫开了。后来加进土豆、辣子，吃到盘底再下一把「皮带面」拌汤汁——一只鸡，两种吃法。

It looks like a century-old classic, but Xinjiang big-plate chicken (da pan ji) is barely 40. By most accounts it was created in the late 1980s beside Highway 312 in Shawan, Xinjiang, by a Sichuan-born cook named Li Shilin, who opened a roadside diner there in 1987. It began as a big, cheap, filling dish for long-haul truckers: a whole chicken stir-fried and served on the large tray used to rest dough — customers asked for "one big plate of chicken," and the name stuck. Potatoes and chili came later, and at the bottom you toss in hand-pulled "belt noodles" to soak up the sauce — one chicken, two ways to eat.
